chapter: Rhythm sections, Rampart Street and church music
title: Church music and jazz; Hall's Catholic upbringing
summary: Hall says sanctified church music is the root of rock and roll, and his family was Catholic.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: I was going to ask one more question. Do you think the music of the churches, the songs, the spirituals, ever influenced the jazz bands much? I think so. Do you think kids go to church and hear that music? Yeah, I think so.

I think the thing that they call rock and roll right now, I've been hearing that for years, I used that in the Sanctified Church, these people have been doing that for years, but now the bands are playing in it. That's what it is, rock and roll, that's all rock and roll is.
Did you grow up in a particular church? Which church were you a member?
No, no, all my people were Catholic. Never Catholic? Yeah.
You never heard that type of number?
No, I didn't. It was spiritual. I used to hear the other churches when it's saying. You hear some of that?
Yeah, I hear some of that.
